name: Bad Students
desc:
Welcome to Bad Students!

🚨 Teachers will chase you if you're late or caught fighting.

👊 Fight bullies and rivals to earn cash!
💪 Become the strongest by leveling up your skills!
💸 Stack up your cash and become the richest!
😠 Make the teachers rage with funny antics like farting and burping.
🏃‍♀️ Dodge, hide, and escape from the teachers chasing you down!
📋 Ace tests to earn skill points and cash!
🏡 Buy a home that's all yours!
🚗 Buy and drive a variety of awesome cars!
🎁 Get free in-game rewards every 12 hours!
👍 Show your support by leaving a like to see more updates in the future!
